basis: Reuse admitted Lab Workspace, Product, Project, Work, Artifact and Contract definitions selected in DEFINITIONS.json.
workspace_identity: The durable owning workspace and its Product remain distinct from execution context.
record_scope_ref: The registered native record envelope scope_ref binds the existing host authority domain required by native permission checks. It does not assign a semantic Project or change the owning workspace.
custody: Workspace identity and its own scope are retained explicitly in the owner-reviewed custody assignment and authenticated record catalog.
work_guard: A Work still requires its real semantic Project and may not use this product-only bridge to invent one.
runtime_policy: One shared implementation; no runtime copies.
input_target_contract: The exact target body, workspace, workspace scope, native authority scope and owner must be reviewed together.
